what: A job that ends on the weekly limit (a seven_day window of the stream at 100 % or rejected, or the command's text says weekly limit) is told apart from the 5-hour window: it waits until that reset + 10 min (up to 8 days, not counted in the 3 resumes) and goes on in the same session; an unknown weekly reset is never guessed, the job looks again every hour (#2196)
